question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **efficiency**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Efficiency **means the ability to achieve maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort, time, or resources. (न्यूनतम बर्बाद प्रयास, समय या संसाधनों के साथ अधिकतम उत्पादकता प्राप्त करने की क्षमता)

 
 
• **Example: ***In a manufacturing plant, the implementation of new technology significantly improved efficiency.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**efficiency**" is a key aspect of the improvements brought about by technological innovations in the extension of financial services.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adequacy: **Having enough or sufficient quality or quantity; meeting the requirements or standards. (पर्याप्त या पर्याप्त गुणवत्ता या मात्रा होना; आवश्यकताओं या मानकों को पूरा करना)
 
• **Inadequacy: **Lacking in quality, quantity, or meeting the required standards; insufficient or not up to the mark. (गुणवत्ता, मात्रा या आवश्यक मानकों को पूरा करने में कमी; अपर्याप्त या लक्ष्य के अनुरूप नहीं)
 
• **Inefficiency: **Not achieving maximum productivity or effectiveness; lacking in efficiency or competence. (अधिकतम उत्पादकता या प्रभावशीलता प्राप्त नहीं करना; दक्षता या योग्यता में कमी)
